summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Alyvn/ClinoveAI marketing site. Backend contact API and health endpoint verified via pytest (4/4 passed). Frontend Playwright suite validated all 9 routes render on dark navy theme, hero WebGL canvas + 3D panels (all 4 labels) render, Recharts charts + stats section render, Navbar Contact CTA works, contact form POST returns 200 with id and shows success state + toast, Legal tabs switch content, no navbar overlap, and zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used in POST /contact (line 67) BEFORE it's defined (line 110). Works today because the module-level statement runs at import; still, recommend moving logging config above route definitions for clarity.
Contact endpoint has no email format validation beyond type=str; consider EmailStr from pydantic for stronger validation.
CORS origins default to '*' which is fine for public marketing but should be tightened in production.
seed_data_creation: Test contact submissions created with TEST_ prefix in db.contact_submissions
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 routes + hero panels + charts + contact POST persistence + legal tabs verified end-to-end. Contact form data-testids: contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-organization, contact-message, contact-submit, contact-success. Hero panels: hero-3d-panels. Charts: stats-section, charts-section. Legal: legal-tab-privacy, legal-tab-terms.
